title: KADEEZY MUSIC — Provenance Anchor Public Entity Record and Disambiguation Packet
creator: Lee Sharks
description:
This record duplicates #840’s KADEEZY MUSIC provenance-anchor draft exactly. The frozen bodies have the same content and the same Git object SHA. Both contain the same public-data snapshot, critical interpretations, disambiguation matrix, archive relation, and final statement that artist review and consent were pending and that the document had not been deposited.

The duplicate does not supply independent confirmation of the facts or consent. It is a registry-level duplication defect unless external metadata establishes a deliberate relation such as concept record versus version record, replacement versus source, or separate file packaging. No such difference appears in the bodies themselves.

If both persistent identifiers must remain, one should be designated canonical and the other explicitly linked as a duplicate, prior version, or superseded record. Search and wiki surfaces should not present two equivalent authority records, because repetition can falsely increase apparent source density and make a pending third-party profile look multiply verified.

The substantive description is therefore the same as #840, but this record’s principal identity is its duplication status.
